hero.title: Returns and RTO diagnostic
hero.subtitle: Audit Amazon Returns Report XML for return reasons, RTO patterns, and cost drivers.

intro: Upload the Returns Report XML from Seller Central. Summaries of reasons and quantities are computed locally.

tips.title: Top reasons
tips.body: Fix listing accuracy and packaging for the highest-volume reasons first.

tips.title: RTO spikes
tips.body: Check address quality and courier lanes for undelivered returns.

tips.title: SKU focus
tips.body: Concentrate quality work on SKUs with elevated return rates.
